title: tunedeck launcher icon (headphones)
objective: The shared app_icons generator registers `tunedeck` with a new `headphones` glyph that stays inside SAFE_BOX and reads at 48dp, without a per-repo copy of the generator, while apps.py stays under the 250-line cap.
acceptance_criteria: generate --app tunedeck --android --web writes assets/icon/*, the Android mipmaps and the web icons
python_pkg/app_icons stays at 100% line and branch coverage; every file <= 250 lines
every other app's registry entry is unchanged (tutor only moves module)
out_of_scope: Changing style.py or any other app's glyph
Committing the generated files in ~/src/tunedeck from this repo
verifier: pytest --cov=python_pkg.app_icons --cov-branch; the generate and preview commands; pre-commit hooks on the staged files
